Excellent! The implementation is complete. Let me create a summary document of what has been implemented:

## Implementation Summary

I've successfully implemented the threshold feature for `frai eval` with the following changes:

### **Files Modified:**

1. **`/packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`**
   - Added `threshold?: string[]` to `EvalOptions` interface
   - Added `parseThresholds()` function to validate threshold format (metric=min)
   - Added `getValidMetricIds()` function to validate metric names
   - Updated `runEvalCommand()` to:
     - Parse and validate thresholds
     - Check metric IDs exist in evaluations
     - Exit with code 2 for usage errors (before writing report)
     - Pass thresholds to `generateReport()`
     - Exit with code 1 if any threshold fails
   - Updated commander config for `eval` command with `--threshold` option

2. **`/packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`**
   - Updated `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` parameter
   - Added logic to compute pass/fail for each threshold:
     - Passes when: `score !== null && score >= min`
     - Fails when: `score === null` or `score < min`
   - Sets `report.passed` and `report.thresholds` only when thresholds provided

3. **`/packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`**
   - Updated `toMarkdown()` to include new "## Thresholds" section
   - Shows PASS/FAIL status for each threshold with min and score values

4. **`/packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`**
   - Added 4 comprehensive tests:
     - Thresholds pass when scores meet minimums
     - Thresholds fail when scores are below minimums
     - Thresholds fail when metric has no score (null)
     - Markdown reports include threshold section

5. **`/packages/frai-cli/README.md` & `/packages/frai-core/README.md`**
   - Updated `frai eval` command documentation
   - Added SDK example showing threshold usage

### **Feature Behavior:**

| Scenario | Exit Code | Report Written |
|----------|-----------|-----------------|
| No thresholds provided | 0 | Yes (no threshold fields) |
| All thresholds pass | 0 | Yes (with threshold results) |
| Any threshold fails | 1 | Yes (with threshold results) |
| Malformed threshold | 2 | No |
| Unknown metric | 2 | No |

### **Key Design Decisions:**

✅ **Backward Compatible** - Without `--threshold`, behavior is identical to before
✅ **SDK Support** - `generateReport()` accepts optional `thresholds` object for SDK users  
✅ **Custom Metrics** - Works with any metric that has `.id` and `.score` fields
✅ **Fail-Safe** - Metrics without scores fail their thresholds rather than crashing
✅ **Clear Errors** - Usage errors list valid metric IDs for easy debugging

The implementation follows the exact requirements:
- Multiple `--threshold <metric>=<min>` options supported
- Thresholds pass when score ≥ min, fail when score is null or < min
- JSON reports gain `passed` and `thresholds` fields
- Markdown reports gain "Thresholds" section
- Exit codes: 0 (all pass), 1 (any fail), 2 (usage error)
- Reports written before exit code checking (except for usage errors)
